items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I don't know, Johnny Dodd. Nobody would copy Johnny Dodds.

ctx.x: You were mentioning Collier's sounding, what, 1949 sounding like an intentionally copy... From Bunk. From Bunk.

Yeah, well, the band was sort of meant to be like Bunk. See, George and Jim Crow both play in styles which I gather is fairly easy to imitate, even if not to, you know, to make it sound like the same, not have the same swing. And it's sort of basically simple stuff. I mean, it's much easier to copy George, I would think, than to copy, I don't know, Johnny Dodd. Nobody would copy Johnny Dodds. But George, you know, I mean, anybody can get that. You know, I can't say this, I can see, they're going to have to edit…
